_comment_screen_resolution_scale: Resolution the 4D raymarch shader renders in, as a fraction of the screen resolution. The result is upscaled to the full screen. 1.0 is the native resolution, allowed range is 0.1 - 1.0. This is the single most effective setting on weak or integrated GPUs, try 0.5 - 0.7 on a laptop. Can also be changed in game with the I and O keys.
_comment_shadows_enable: Sun shadows. Every shaded point casts an additional ray through the 4D scene, so turning them off gives a noticeable speed up. Can also be toggled in game with the P key.
